_note: Druid (2024), a full caster. Reconstructed from shipped generated data to restore the build source of truth.

classes.name: Druid
startingEquipment: Leather Armor, Shield, Sickle, Quarterstaff (Druidic Focus), Explorer's Pack, Herbalism Kit, 9 GP
classes.flavor: A keeper of the primal world who prepares nature's magic and takes the shape of beasts — a shapeshifting caster and wilderness guide.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Druid spells using Wisdom, preparing a growing list (shown on the table) plus cantrips from the full Druid list each day. Save DC is 8 + Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus. You use a Druidic Focus (or the like) as your focus.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids, and can leave hidden messages that only those who know it (or use magic) can perceive. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared.

features.name: Primal Order
features.description: Choose your path: Magician (an extra Druid cantrip, and you add your Wisdom modifier to Arcana and Nature checks) or Warden (proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor).

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can transform into a Beast you've learned, for a number of hours; you gain the form's physical stats and abilities and Temporary HP, keeping your mind and some traits. You have a number of uses per rest (shown on the table).

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without a slot, summoning a nature spirit in animal form.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.description: Once per turn, if you have no Wild Shape uses left, you can expend a spell slot to regain one. You can also convert a Wild Shape use into a level 1 spell slot once per Long Rest.

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.description: Choose one: Potent Spellcasting (add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Druid cantrips) or Primal Strike (once per turn while in Wild Shape, deal extra elemental damage — a d8 of Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder — on a hit).

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.description: Your Elemental Fury choice improves: the cantrip range increases, or the Primal Strike damage die grows to a d10.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast spells in Wild Shape form, using your natural abilities in place of the usual Somatic and Verbal components (Material components still needed).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Dimensional Travel is a fitting choice.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times, you can ignore the Verbal and Somatic components of your Druid spells, and you can convert unexpended Wild Shape uses to regain spell slots. You also age far more slowly.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.flavor: A druid bound to a particular land — desert, mountains, forest, or coast — drawing extra spells and protection from it.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: You gain a set of always-prepared Circle Spells tied to a chosen land type (Arid, Polar, Temperate, or Tropical). As a Magic action you can expend a Wild Shape use to sap life in a 10-foot area: enemies take Necrotic damage (a Constitution save for half) and one creature is healed.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Once per day on a Short Rest you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Druid level, and you can cast one of your Circle Spells without a slot once per Long Rest.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You're immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type determined by your land choice.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: As a Magic action you conjure protective spirits in a 15-foot Cube for 1 minute; you and your allies in it gain Half Cover and Resistance to your land's damage type, and you can move the effect on later turns.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.flavor: A fierce shapeshifter who wades into battle as a dire beast, mending wounds mid-transformation.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Your Wild Shape forms are combat-ready: you can take on more powerful Beasts, gain extra Temporary HP based on your Druid level, and your natural attacks count as magical. You also learn to expend a spell slot as a Bonus Action to heal in beast form.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can teleport up to 30 feet and gain Advantage on your next attack. You have a number of uses per Long Rest (regained by spending a spell slot).

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: While in Wild Shape you add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saves, and you can spend a Wild Shape use to add Radiant damage to your natural attacks.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: Your beast forms gain extra Radiant damage once per turn, and when you use Moonlight Step you can bring an ally along.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Sea
subclasses.flavor: A druid of tides and storms who wraps themselves in a lashing sea and rides the wind.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: You gain Sea-tied Circle Spells. As a Bonus Action you can expend a Wild Shape use to surround yourself with a spectral sea aura for 10 minutes; when you hit a creature in it with a spell you can push it and deal Cold damage.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: The radius of your Wrath of the Sea aura grows, you gain a Swim Speed, and you can breathe underwater.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While your aura is active you gain a Fly Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: You can share your Wrath of the Sea aura with an ally, and its damage increases.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Stars
subclasses.flavor: A stargazer who charts the constellations and takes on their radiant, guiding forms.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: You record a Star Map that acts as a Druidic Focus and grants extra Guidance/Guiding Bolt casts. As a Bonus Action you can expend a Wild Shape use to take a glowing Starry Form for 10 minutes — Archer (a radiant ranged attack), Chalice (healing when you cast healing spells), or Dragon (steady Concentration and better checks).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a Long Rest, roll a die to determine a Weal or Woe omen; you can use a Reaction to add or subtract a d6 on rolls made by creatures near you.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Your Starry Form improves — the Archer and Chalice dice grow to d10s, the Dragon grants a Fly Speed, and you can change your form each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form you become partly incorporeal, gaining Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
